//  ------------------------------ | ITEM - MUTED GROUP | ------------------------------  //

  return (
    <ItemGroup>

      <Item variant="muted">

          <ItemTitle>Item 2</ItemTitle>
          <ItemDescription>Second item in muted group.</ItemDescription>
        </ItemContent>

      </Item>
      <Item variant="muted">
        <ItemContent>
          <ItemTitle>Item 3</ItemTitle>
          <ItemDescription>Third item in muted group.</ItemDescription>
        </ItemContent>
        <ItemActions>
          <Button size="sm">Action</Button>
        </ItemActions>
      </Item>
    </ItemGroup>
  )
}
